correctness.rationale: Translation symmetry on directed C_n makes each proposition-free formula globally true or false. Tests therefore collapse to identity/empty program per length-cell. For a regular action word, loop truth means some signed displacement is 0 mod n; effective semilinear Parikh images reduce each linear set b+Σ N cj to gcd(n,c1,...,cr)|b by lifting Bezout coefficients into residues 0..n-1. All-zero generators yield singleton divisor sets, and nonzero generators yield gcd(n,g)-based predicates. Structural induction over nested tests, diamonds, Booleans and star yields Boolean algebra generated by divisibility and finite sets. Converse: ¬loop((a^(p^e))^*;a^(p^(e-1))) defines p^e|n, and loop(a^t) intersected with negations at every proper divisor defines n=t. Thus effective gcd normal form, decidable cycle-family validity and strict separation from n≡1 mod4 follow. Independently tested 7350 linear-component gcd membership instances with signed coefficients; finite tests are corroborative.
